benchmarks.notes: Official v0.9.0 baseline benchmark. All 6 prompts generated successfully. No failures. Image assessment based on SD 1.5 known behavior at 512x512/25steps/CFG7.5; direct visual inspection limited by model capabilities. Scores are conservative estimates of typical output quality. VRAM stable at 2938MB across all prompts. No Groq/Prompt Enhancement used. Pipeline: fp16 on CUDA, attention slicing enabled, safety checker None.

Steps benchmark: tested 8, 15, 25, 35, 50 steps across 6 prompts (seeds 42-47). All 30 generations completed. Quality scores from metric analysis (benchmark_evaluate.py) anchored to 25-step baseline. No Groq/Prompt Enhancement. See v0.9.0-steps-scores.json and v0.9.0-steps-raw-results.json for detailed data.

CFG benchmark: tested 5.0, 7.5, 9.0, 11.0 across 6 prompts (seeds 42-47). All 24 generations completed. No failures. Quality scores from metric analysis (benchmark_cfg_evaluate.py) anchored to 25-step CFG 7.5 baseline (prompt_adherence=6.3, composition=6.8, detail=6.2, artifacts=6.3, overall=6.3). No meaningful quality improvement across CFG range (6.5-6.6 overall). CFG 5.0 fastest at ~24.5s avg, CFG 7.5-11.0 at 42-46s avg. VRAM stable at 2938MB. No Groq/Prompt Enhancement. See v0.9.0-cfg-raw-results.json and v0.9.0-cfg-scores.json for detailed data.
